family: E: Waiting and reciprocity (10 dynamics; /Users/ren/theories/theories/becoming/results/atlas/entries/dynamics.json; Lean in Becoming/Withholding.lean, Tolerance.lean, WindowedWaiting.lean, PairChance.lean, PairSelection.lean, PairFlow.lean and systems-complexity/analysis/SeededContinuation.lean)
in_one_paragraph: Family E has 135 Lean laws (2 further declarations are definitions), 14 exits, 5 transitions, 3 compose entries, no bound test and no actual case; 63 of the 135 take no ledger premise. I read every statement. The foundation HOLDS in three places. (1) The family's central object is a root line in the literal sense: a holding-back carried from member to member along the waits (Withholding.lean's docstring: "Here the carried thing is withholding"), and the four marks fit it well: it forms as one lapse, lasts by staying or by coming round a loop, spreads, and ends by passing out, being gone without, or stopping at a member that gives first. (2) The 56 laws that state one built case or one named way of answering land whole as cases and meetings, and E already has Lean theorems that are meetings (Tolerance.Ring.restores_from_three: "an instance of restores_from"; nine case_of entries). (3) The six laws that only equate two models' statements (Tolerance.web_tolerating, PairFlow.Routes.line_offspring and others) land in the line record as joins proved, where both earlier reports had left them "unresolved". It BENDS in four places. The commonest conclusion among the 32 general laws that put a line at a mark is "stays ended, does not form again" (9 of 32), which is none of the four marks unless an absence is itself a line. 16 of the 79 general laws have an IF about the shape of the web of waits (a chain, a loop, everything within d, a set closed up to what each goes without), and the law record has no slot for reach. The main IF everywhere is a standing arrangement (how each member answers) that no law shows forming, changing or ending, so every "exit" of the family is a difference between two arrangements, not a change the course makes. "Changes" needs a direction, and THEN needs a when and a strength (enough, needed, exactly). It BREAKS on the 17 general laws that relate two courses (an order between starts kept, the start with nothing given standing for every start, more waiting gives no more, no reading tells two runs apart): no line is put at a mark. The draft's r6 is worded as mutual; the laws are about a directed tie of any shape, which on the World is the draft's r3 with r4 (Tolerance.web_tolerating). Tallies of statement shape are mine, by reading; the 63, 135, 14, 5, 3 and the case_of count are computed from dynamics.json.

CHANGES: only as two fixed relations compared (Withholding.waitsAll_more_waiting, answers_more_waiting; premise withholding-more-waiting). ENDS: no law. All four marks are blank; its SHAPES carry the laws: a chain of k (Withholding.Chain, premise withholding-chain), within d (Within, premise withholding-all-within-d), a loop (Chain up p b b), clear of members that give first (Tolerance.Clear), a set closed up to what each goes without (AllBut G (tol a) (ups a)), separated fault sets (premise faultenvelopes-separated). laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: with memory, for every member (taken as given for the whole course). r6: the members within n waits of a. Time: step n.
laws.then_: NEW-giving of a: present at step n exactly where every member within n waits of a gave at the start.
laws.kind: border (a closed form of the whole course)
laws.note: The family's generating law: stays, spreads and absorbs follow from it; answers_closed is its twin without memory ('exactly n waits'). The THEN ties one line's state to the start of many lines by reach along the waits; the law form has no slot for reach with a length. Docstring: a case of the grammar's «存承之迭».

laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: with memory. NEW-giving of a: absent at step n.
laws.then_: NEW-giving of a: absent at every later step. Read on NEW-lapse: lasts.
laws.kind: lasts (of the holding-back); said of the giving it is 'stays ended', which is none of the four marks
laws.note: takes withholding-waitsall-withholds-at. Two typers will split between 'giving: ended' and 'holding-back: lasts' unless the foundation says an absence is a line. The root has it on the World: 'A formation ceasing is the beginning, at the next step, of a line of inactivity' (Web.ceases_iff_inactive_sheng, 01 §3).

laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: with memory. NEW-giving of b: absent at the start. r6: a chain of k waits from b to a. Time: step n at or after k.
laws.then_: NEW-giving of a: absent at step n. On NEW-lapse: changes (spreads to a within k steps).
laws.kind: ends
laws.note: The cleanest example in the family of 'one line's ending is among the conditions of another's'. It needs reach along a tie, with a length (takes withholding-chain, withholding-chain-within-steps).

laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: with memory. NEW-giving of b: absent at the start. r6: every member lies within d waits of b (a condition on the whole web). Time: step n at or after d.
laws.then_: NEW-giving of every member: absent at every step from d on.
laws.kind: ends

It is in the entry's mechanism and declarations and in no exit, transition or compose; E-process.json: a map drawn from items 'will show many ways out of the stand-off and almost none in, which is the reverse of what the theorems say'. Typed from the Lean, it is back. Strain: the IF is a shape of the whole web.

laws.then_: The two courses agree at every member k steps after those steps, for every k.
laws.kind: other: between two courses (they merge)

laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: without memory. r6: no chain of L waits exists anywhere in the web. Time: step n at or after L. Whatever the start.
laws.then_: NEW-giving of every member: present at every step from L on. On NEW-lapse: ends (passes out off the end of the chains).
laws.kind: forms (giving comes back); ends (of the holding-back)
laws.note: A whole-web shape plus 'whatever the start'. The atlas files it as an exit that drops withholding-chain: a different web, not a change the course makes.

laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: without memory. NEW-giving of b: absent at the start. r6: a chain of p waits from b back to b (a loop).
laws.then_: NEW-giving of b: absent at every step k·p. On NEW-lapse: lasts by returning.
laws.kind: lasts (returning)
laws.note: The draft's 'ways of lasting: returning' fits. The Lean does not say the course has period p, nor anything of the steps between (F's entry says so). The same theorem is listed under F withholding-returns-around-a-loop.

laws.if_: Two webs of waits, the second holding every wait of the first and more; the same start; with memory in both. NEW-giving of a: present at step n under the web with more waits.
laws.then_: NEW-giving of a: present at step n under the web with fewer.
laws.kind: other: between two arrangements (more waiting gives no more)
laws.note: The only law in the family in which the waiting relation differs, and it compares two fixed relations; nothing shows a wait forming or ending. Docstring: 'that an added wait takes some giving away is not shown'.

laws.if_: Built case: three members in a ring, each waiting on the one before; one holds back at the start; with memory.
laws.then_: Seen (proved): every member's giving absent from step 2 on; at step 1 the third still gives.
laws.kind: other: a built case with a meeting (an instance of withholding_absorbs, and its bound d = 2 shown tight)
laws.note: Not a law. It lands whole as case plus meeting, and the meeting does two jobs: the IF is met and the THEN seen; the THEN cannot be made earlier.

laws.if_: Built case: the same ring, without memory.
laws.then_: Seen: at each step exactly one member holds back; the first at 3k, the second at 3k+1, the third at 3k+2.
laws.kind: other: a built case (the holding-back lasts by returning)
laws.note: The case shows more than the general law it meets: withholding_returns gives only the multiples of p at one member. A sighting can outrun its law, so a meeting needs room for 'seen beyond what was predicted'.

laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: of the sort that keeps inclusion (more giving now gives no less next).
laws.then_: A member gives at step n from every start exactly where it gives at n from the start at which nothing gives.
laws.kind: other: between courses (one start stands for all)
laws.note: This is what licenses 'from every start' in the restoring laws. It is reasoning about the whole set of cases under one arrangement: which one case decides for all. Lines and marks have no place for it.

laws.if_: NEW-how-it-answers: keeps inclusion. Two starts, the first giving only where the second gives.

laws.kind: other: between two courses (an order kept)

counts: Typed: 76 of the family's 135 Lean laws, from the Lean statements and docstrings and the 'takes' lists, plus the one entry that has no Lean (77 items), over all 10 dynamics. Fit is judged against the draft's LAW FORM as written (lines t1..t9, r1..r12; IF marks and comparisons; THEN one line at one mark; kinds forms, lasts, changes, ends, border). Split of the 77: clean 1; needs-comparison 8; needs-new-line 10; strained 20; does-not-fit 38. Of the 38 that do not fit the law form, 26 land whole in another record of the foundation (19 built cases with their meetings; 6 in the line record as joins proved or sorts of a named way; 1 thesis), and 12 land nowhere (10 relate two courses or two arrangements; 1 is a definition unfolded; 1 is a point of logic). If the three new lines and reach along a tie are granted, the 10 needs-new-line become clean, giving 19 of 77 that type without bending. For the whole family, by my reading of all 135 statements (a hand tally of statement shape, not a computed figure): 56 state one built case or one named way of answering; of the 79 general laws, 32 put a line at a mark (forms 6, lasts 5, ends 8, stays ended 9, a share does not rise 4, changes 0), 13 are exact borders, 17 relate two courses or arrangements, 6 equate two models or two ways, 3 say 'not both', 8 bound an amount. Computed from dynamics.json: 63 of the 135 laws take no ledger premise; 9 case_of links; E's 98 premises are shared with other families in 14 ids (the World's k3-balance, k3-decided, flow-gainlesson, web-meton, the two cards, ruleshaping-pos and ruleshaping-some with C, five with F's one entry). No entry of bindings.json and no test in tests.json bears on an E law.
what_does_not_fit:
1. LAWS ABOUT EVERY COURSE AT ONCE. Tolerance.worst_start, KeepsInclusion.course, total_withholding_merges, the 'more gives no less' laws (waitsAll_more_waiting, tolerating_mono, window_mono), and the 'agree until' laws of PairFlow (levels_agree_until, runs_agree_until, lines_agree_while_active, factors_equal): 17 of the 79 general laws. Lines and four marks MISS them: nothing is put at a mark. What they are: laws about how cases stand to one another under one arrangement (an order between starts is kept; one start decides for all; two courses merge; a difference in one line makes no difference to another). They are what lets a sighting in one case bear on another case, so they belong to the reasoning-and-situation question Ren asks for, and need a kind of their own. The same misfit is already in the first region: rows.json left Becoming.Law.perturbation_reabsorbed unplaced, asking for 'a shape for an absorbed push'. Staying in a region: Tolerance.kept_set STRAINS; its subject is a set of lines closed under their own waits up to what each goes without.

2. LAWS THAT COMPARE AMOUNTS. The draft's comparison in the IF HOLDS eight typed here (sparing_gives, total_stays, the window against a run of lapses, β against γ). It STRAINS where the THEN is itself a comparison (PairFlow.Routes.gap_iff: comparison exactly where comparison; met_needs_within_start; rise_le_slack_inflow, which is the contrapositive of a mark law of family B) and where the comparison has no plain words (answering_rises_iff, a five-parameter inequality). PairChance.absorbed_share bounds a share of courses: it needs 'in all but at most this share of the courses' on the THEN.

3. THE SHAPE OF A WHOLE WEB. A chain from b to a and a loop through b fit once a law may say 'k waits downstream of' (reach, 及, is in the draft's word list and in no slot of its law record). Whole-web conditions STRAIN: no chain of L anywhere (gives_without_chain), every member within d (withholding_absorbs), no clear chain into a (restores_iff), separated fault sets (certified_available_iff), a set closed up to tolerance (kept_set, thin_absorbed). 16 of the 79 general laws carry such a condition. What they are: conditions on the ties themselves, the map's own topology; in the root's terms, reach and the absence or presence of a cycle. The line kinds are few; the laws are about how many instances of one kind are arranged.

4. WITNESSES. 56 of 135. The foundation HOLDS them better than the atlas does (which draws four as exits with strength 'witness'): each is a built case with sightings, and E has Lean theorems that are meetings. But a meeting needs to say which of five jobs the case does: instance (Ring.restores_from_three), a bound shown tight (Ring.waitsAll_absorbs_exact, NeedsAtCapacity.at_capacity), an IF item shown needed (erring_answerer_exceeds, certified_blocked), a possibility shown (Routes.signs, among_discord_witness), or standing alone with no law (FailedRenewal.lines_gain, Renewed.renewal_carried, all of SeededContinuation). Two further bends: a built case's sightings are proved, not observed, so only its bridge to anything actual can be wrong; and lines_gain is a comparison of two built cases, which 'a case and a law' does not cover.

5. CALIBRATIONS AND DEFINITIONS. window_witness (12 against a bound of 15) and at_capacity are notes on a law's edge: held as meetings. ignition_requires_actual_reserve is a definition unfolded and reciprocal_eventual_promises_can_be_empty a point of logic: MISSED, and rightly; neither is a tie on the map. The seven rfl facts of PairChance (which named ways hold back after both held back) are a table in a line record.

6. OTHER KINDS THE FAMILY SHOWS. (a) Identifications: tolerating_zero, web_tolerating, giftWeb_tolerating, Routes.line_offspring, Routes.plain, window_echo_shaped. Not laws about marks; HELD by the line record ('joined by a proof'). (b) 'Not both' over ways of answering: keeps_split, keeps_not_both, not_absorbs_and_answers_spaced, and the border restores_and_answers_iff. STRAIN: the subject is the way of answering and the two outcomes are marks in two different set-ups. (c) 'Stays ended, does not form': the largest group of mark laws (9 of 32) and none of the four marks as worded. (d) Needed conditions: gives_needs_sparing has a THEN that is a fact about the arrangement. (e) A reading taken as given inside the IF: Place.received_factor_le, factors_equal. The bridge is then inside the reasoning, which the three-way split does not yet show. (f) Direction: every selection law here concludes rises, falls or does not rise; bare 'changes' loses it.

7. THE ARRANGEMENT. The family's main IF is how each member answers, and the web of waits. Neither is at a mark in any law: both are taken as lasting. Asked the four questions, both return four blanks, and the entries' opens say so ('How the relation of waiting forms', 'How a law that gives first forms', 'how tolerances form'). The blanks are worth showing. But every exit of the family ('Restoring needs another law') is then a difference between two arrangements, which the draft's law form would store as if the course made it.

better:
Keep lines, the four marks, and the three-way split. Change these, in order of how much of E turns on them.

1. MAKE THE TIES THE GROUND, AND ADD WHAT IS CARRIED ALONG THEM. The draft says 'Lines condition one another. That is the map's topology' and then stores relations as lines among lines. In E the central relation (waits) has four blank marks, and the marks all land on what runs along it. Store ties as their own record: the two kinds of line they join, what is carried along them (a lapse, an amount, a difference), how long a step takes, and their shapes (chain, loop, within d, a set closed under them). Add the line the draft lacks: a difference carried along the ties (a lapse, a push, a loss). It is E's main line, F's, and the one rows.json asked for under Law.perturbation_reabsorbed. Keep line KINDS (few, the map's ground) apart from INSTANCES (many, in a case or in a law's roles: this one, another k ties downstream, every one, a set), and give the law record a slot for reach with a length.

2. SAY THAT AN ABSENCE IS A LINE. 'Stays ended, does not form again' is the largest group of E's mark laws. Either each line carries its absence as a line (the root does this on the World: Web.ceases_iff_inactive_sheng), each such law stored once on the side that is positive ('the holding-back lasts'), or 'does not form' becomes a fifth answer. Without a rule two typers will split on Tolerance.total_stays.

3. TYPE THE IF ITEMS. Four sorts: an arrangement taken as lasting for the whole course (including which sort a line is of: how it answers, keeps inclusion); a mark at a time; a comparison; a reading taken as given (an identification assumed, as in Place.received_factor_le). The second prototype had the first two as 'setup' and 'state'; the draft lost them. Then say of every tie whether the course itself makes the change or it is a difference between two arrangements. In E all 14 exits are the second.

4. GIVE THE THEN A WHEN, A WHICH-WAY AND A STRENGTH. When: from step n on; at every multiple of p; whatever the start. Which way, for 'changes': rises, falls, alternates, spreads, does not. Strength: enough, needed, exactly, in one built case, in all but a share of the courses. And allow a THEN that is a comparison, or fix one direction for storing a law and its contrapositive.

5. ADD TWO KINDS OF LAW. 'Between two courses' (carries over; one stands for all; merges; makes no difference) and 'not both' (over arrangements). The first is the reasoning that moves a sighting from one case to another, which is close to what Ren asked the map to show.

6. MEETINGS. Add what the case does for the law (instance; bound shown tight; an IF item shown needed; a possibility shown; stands alone), room for 'seen beyond what was predicted' (Ring.answers_circulates), and meetings between two cases. For each IF item say how it was settled: seen as a mark, set by construction, inferred from the course, or assumed. An arrangement such as 'holds back after both held back twice' concerns a response to a state that may never occur; it cannot be sighted as a mark, in a built case it is set, and in an actual case it could only be inferred. The bridge then has three levels to keep apart: model to model proved (line record), model to model assumed (inside a law's IF), model to actual (the meeting). E has the first two and none of the third: the map should show the family plainly as ties with no actual sighting.

7. THE DRAFT'S LIST. Reword r6 as a directed tie ('its giving waits on that one's giving'); mutual waiting is a loop of it; note that on the World it is r3 with r4 between two members (web_tolerating), proved only for webs where each member needs its own condition alone. Add 'how it answers' as a line whose four marks are blank in every law.

8. WORDS. Four of the map's working words already mean something else inside E's own Lean and atlas. 'Law': here the account's 'law of giving' is an object in the model ('Restoring needs another law'), not a proved statement. 'Line': PairFlow's 'line' is a line of descent (lineAt, 'the level of a line'), Withholding.Line is a built case of two members in a row, and the glossary's line (相续) is the reach of continuation between occurrences. 'Rule': the draft's t7 picks among kinds; a way of answering is not that. 'Place': PairSelection.Place is a side of a pair. Pick one sense each and rename the others on the map ('how it answers', 'what it leaves'). The Lean and the two earlier reports also lean on words for persons or organisms (partner, promise, childless, offspring; 'nobody gives', 'someone gives first', 'grudge', 'patience', 'neighbours'). Words that held up across every E law: member, gives, holds back, waits on, goes without, lapse, looks back w steps, gives first, stands, what it leaves.

A check worth running before the store is built: two typers each type the same 20 E laws under the amended form. I expect them to split on the stays-ended laws, on which side of a contrapositive to store, and on whether a law about a built model (SeededContinuation.active_run_iff) is a law or a case.
